timing_definition: inclusive includes nested spans; self subtracts direct children on the same thread; do not sum parent and child inclusive_s
resource_definition: RUSAGE_SELF CPU deltas; maxrss is process-lifetime Linux KiB, not a stage-local allocation peak
performance_scope: Independent instrumented CPU delivery; not pipeline latency or GPU time

configuration.overrides: encoder_workers only; other values use recorded production defaults

bake.timing_definition: Export wall time excluding disjoint main-thread compact/write/join intervals; includes baking overlapped by encoding workers
bake.appearance: Static source-texture baking; view-dependent Gaussian blending is not reproduced

compact.timing_definition: Main-thread geometry/image/final-write wall time plus encoding join; excludes overlapping worker execution
